mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attractions WHERE no = #{targetId})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_stats (target_type, target_id, review_count, rating_sum, avg_rating) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{countDelta}, #{ratingDelta}, CASE WHEN #{countDelta} > 0 THEN #{ratingDelta} / #{countDelta} ELSE 0 END) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE review_count = review_count + #{countDelta}, rating_sum = rating_sum + #{ratingDelta}, avg_rating = CASE WHEN review_count > 0 THEN rating_sum / review_count ELSE 0 END
